force_target: cross-fitted unrestricted ridge scaled-grad mean force
block_protocol: The same twenty 0.25 ps blocks are used throughout. Weights fitted on ten alternating blocks are applied to the other ten, then the roles are exchanged. The SEM is calculated from all twenty cross-fitted block estimates.
regularization: The ridge strength is selected inside each ten-block training fold by a two-way five-block/five-block grid search with the one-standard-error rule.
source_provenance_note: Source identifiers describe the original calculations; raw trajectories are not included in this repository.
